{
  "dataset_name": "spambase",
  "model_family": "tree",
  "schema_generator": "claude-sonnet-4.6",
  "schema_version": "1.0",
  "features": [
    {
      "name": "capital_run_log_total",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Log-transformed total capital run length to compress heavy right tail while preserving ordering signal",
      "value_range": [0.0, 9.22],
      "feature_family": "capital_runs",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a more normally distributed version of capital_run_length_total for cleaner tree splits",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.log1p(capital_run_length_total)"
    },
    {
      "name": "capital_run_longest_log",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Log-transformed longest capital run length to reduce skew and enable better threshold splits",
      "value_range": [0.0, 9.21],
      "feature_family": "capital_runs",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Enables cleaner splits on longest capital sequence, a strong spam indicator",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.log1p(capital_run_length_longest)"
    },
    {
      "name": "capital_avg_to_longest_ratio",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Ratio of average capital run length to longest capital run length, indicating consistency of capitalization bursts",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "capital_runs",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures whether capitalization is concentrated in one burst vs spread out; spam often has extreme bursts",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "capital_run_length_average / np.maximum(capital_run_length_longest, 1.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "exclamation_dollar_combined",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Sum of exclamation mark frequency (char_freq_4) and dollar sign frequency (char_freq_3), both strong spam indicators",
      "value_range": [0.0, 37.78],
      "feature_family": "char_frequencies",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Combines two highly discriminative punctuation features into a single additive signal for tree splits",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "char_freq_3 + char_freq_4"
    },
    {
      "name": "dollar_sign_present",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Boolean indicator for presence of dollar sign character in email",
      "value_range": [0, 1],
      "feature_family": "char_frequencies",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Direct boolean split on dollar sign presence, a strong spam indicator for financial solicitations",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where(char_freq_3 > 0.0, 1, 0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "high_capital_burst_flag",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Boolean flag indicating unusually long capital run sequences (longest > 20), associated with aggressive spam formatting",
      "value_range": [0, 1],
      "feature_family": "capital_runs",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a direct boolean split on extreme capitalization behavior common in spam",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where(capital_run_length_longest > 20, 1, 0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "spam_word_cluster_score",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Weighted sum of high-frequency spam-associated word features: word_freq_18 (your), word_freq_20 (re), word_freq_24 (free), word_freq_26 (business)",
      "value_range": [0.0, 60.0],
      "feature_family": "word_frequencies",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Aggregates multiple spam-associated word frequencies into a single score for efficient tree splitting",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "word_freq_18 + word_freq_20 + word_freq_24 * 2.0 + word_freq_26"
    },
    {
      "name": "nonzero_word_count",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Count of word frequency features with non-zero values, indicating vocabulary breadth of the email",
      "value_range": [0, 48],
      "feature_family": "word_frequencies",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures email vocabulary diversity; spam may use fewer but more targeted words",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(np.where(word_freq_0 > 0, 1, 0) + np.where(word_freq_1 > 0, 1, 0) + np.where(word_freq_2 > 0, 1, 0) + np.where(word_freq_3 > 0, 1, 0) + np.where(word_freq_4 > 0, 1, 0) + np.where(word_freq_5 > 0, 1, 0) + np.where(word_freq_6 > 0, 1, 0) + np.where(word_freq_7 > 0, 1, 0) + np.where(word_freq_8 > 0, 1, 0) + np.where(word_freq_9 > 0, 1, 0) + np.where(word_freq_10 > 0, 1, 0) + np.where(word_freq_11 > 0, 1, 0) + np.where(word_freq_12 > 0, 1, 0) + np.where(word_freq_13 > 0, 1, 0) + np.where(word_freq_14 > 0, 1, 0) + np.where(word_freq_15 > 0, 1, 0) + np.where(word_freq_16 > 0, 1, 0) + np.where(word_freq_17 > 0, 1, 0) + np.where(word_freq_18 > 0, 1, 0) + np.where(word_freq_19 > 0, 1, 0) + np.where(word_freq_20 > 0, 1, 0) + np.where(word_freq_21 > 0, 1, 0) + np.where(word_freq_22 > 0, 1, 0) + np.where(word_freq_23 > 0, 1, 0) + np.where(word_freq_24 > 0, 1, 0) + np.where(word_freq_25 > 0, 1, 0) + np.where(word_freq_26 > 0, 1, 0) + np.where(word_freq_27 > 0, 1, 0) + np.where(word_freq_28 > 0, 1, 0) + np.where(word_freq_29 > 0, 1, 0) + np.where(word_freq_30 > 0, 1, 0) + np.where(word_freq_31 > 0, 1, 0) + np.where(word_freq_32 > 0, 1, 0) + np.where(word_freq_33 > 0, 1, 0) + np.where(word_freq_34 > 0, 1, 0) + np.where(word_freq_35 > 0, 1, 0) + np.where(word_freq_36 > 0, 1, 0) + np.where(word_freq_37 > 0, 1, 0) + np.where(word_freq_38 > 0, 1, 0) + np.where(word_freq_39 > 0, 1, 0) + np.where(word_freq_40 > 0, 1, 0) + np.where(word_freq_41 > 0, 1, 0) + np.where(word_freq_42 > 0, 1, 0) + np.where(word_freq_43 > 0, 1, 0) + np.where(word_freq_44 > 0, 1, 0) + np.where(word_freq_45 > 0, 1, 0) + np.where(word_freq_46 > 0, 1, 0) + np.where(word_freq_47 > 0, 1, 0))"
    },
    {
      "name": "char_special_total",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Total frequency of all special characters (semicolon, parenthesis, bracket, exclamation, dollar, hash) combined",
      "value_range": [0.0, 50.0],
      "feature_family": "char_frequencies",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Aggregated special character usage is a strong discriminator between formal and informal/spam email styles",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "char_freq_0 + char_freq_1 + char_freq_2 + char_freq_3 + char_freq_4 + char_freq_5"
    },
    {
      "name": "capital_intensity_bucket",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Ordinal bucket of capital run total: 0=low (<=50), 1=medium (51-200), 2=high (201-500), 3=very high (>500)",
      "value_range": [0, 3],
      "feature_family": "capital_runs",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides ordinal categorical splits on capital intensity levels, enabling efficient tree partitioning",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where(capital_run_length_total <= 50, 0, np.where(capital_run_length_total <= 200, 1, np.where(capital_run_length_total <= 500, 2, 3)))"
    },
    {
      "name": "free_money_word_interaction",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Product of word_freq_24 (free) and char_freq_3 (dollar sign), capturing co-occurrence of financial spam signals",
      "value_range": [0.0, 540.0],
      "feature_family": "word_char_interaction",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Nonlinear interaction between two strong spam indicators; co-occurrence is more discriminative than either alone",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "word_freq_24 * char_freq_3"
    },
    {
      "name": "email_formality_score",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Semantic assessment of email formality based on balance of formal word indicators (word_freq_11=our, word_freq_20=re) vs informal capitalization and special chars. Score 1=very informal/aggressive to 5=very formal/professional",
      "value_range": [1, 5],
      "feature_family": "semantic_style",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures holistic email style that individual features miss; informal aggressive emails correlate strongly with spam",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    }
  ]
}
